Outsiders was a Russian tag created by Virtus.pro in the wake of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Due to Virtus.pro's ownership group having ties to companies and individuals sanctioned by American and European governments, the Outsiders tag was created as a neutral name for the roster.

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2022
  • 2023
  • Show All
  • March 2nd - ESL announce that Russian organizations with ties to the government are indefinitely banned from competing in their events. [1]
  • March 4th - Virtus.pro confirm they will allow their team to play under a neutral name, which is later confirmed to be Outsiders. [2]
  • April 9th - PGL announce that they will be mirroring ESL's decision to ban Russian organizations with ties to the government. [3]
  • May 23rd - Virtus.pro bench buster and YEKINDAR. [4]
  • May 31st - Virtus.pro acquire n0rb3r7 and fame from K23. [5]
  • October 14th - YEKINDAR buys himself out of his contract and leaves Virtus.pro. [6]
  • November 13th - Outsiders win the IEM Major in Rio de Janeiro, defeating Heroic 2-0 in the grand final.
  • January 8th - Virtus.pro bench n0rb3r7 and acquire KaiR0N- from Aurora Gaming. [7]
  • January 17th - buster is acquired by Cloud9. [8]
  • March 22nd - BLAST lift their sanction against Virtus.pro, as a result, they are allowed to participate in BLAST-organized events under the tag going forward. [9]
  • March 28th - ESL lift their sanction against Virtus.pro, as a result, they are allowed to participate in ESL-organized events under the tag going forward. As a result of these changes, the Outsiders tag is retired. [9]
